title: Storybound phrases
description: data/<namespace>/storybound/phrases/<path>.json — an NPC's short lines, one at a time, without a conversation: its chatter, what it says when hit.

order.description: random: one at random, never the same twice in a row. sequence: top to bottom, then the last one again.

lines.description: Each line is a text said in a bubble over the NPC, or { "dialogue": id } started with the player.

line.description: A text said in a bubble, or a dialogue started with the player.

dialogue.description: Started with the player (in bubbles, subtitles or on the screen, as it says).
